requirements.text: Place the ESP32-C3 module inside the housing

rounds.summary: The ESP32-C3 module is currently placed outside the housing, failing both the interior placement and 1 mm clearance requirements. The housing and button remain unchanged. A repair is provided to move the ESP32-C3 module onto the carrier board inside the housing with ample clearance from the enclosure walls and other internal components.

observations.detail: The ESP32-C3 module is positioned outside the housing to the right rather than inside the enclosure.
Measured check fails with an envelope-to-interior margin of -41.6 mm because the ESP32-C3 module lies outside the housing instead of maintaining at least 1 mm interior clearance.
The housing preserves its original geometry and placement as verified by the deterministic check.
The button preserves its original geometry and placement as verified by the deterministic check.

checks.detail: Component IDs, graph references, motion bounds and source geometry passed deterministic validation.
Procedural envelope metadata agrees with the actual solid bounds within 2% or 0.5 mm; source CAD dimensions are preserved.
Fit tolerances, forces, electrical compatibility, wiring, firmware and physical operation remain unverified.
Minimum envelope-to-interior margin -41.6 mm; required 1 mm. Interior from the actual box floor and four wall faces. Component envelopes are conservative; physical tolerances are unverified.

rounds.summary: The ESP32-C3 module is positioned inside the housing on the carrier board with a 3.8 mm interior margin, satisfying the 1 mm clearance requirement. The housing and button remain unchanged in geometry and placement. Physical operation, electrical compatibility, and manufacturing tolerances remain unverified by visual and geometric checks.

observations.detail: The ESP32-C3 module is visibly positioned inside the housing on the left side of the carrier board.
The ESP32-C3 module maintains a 3.8 mm minimum envelope-to-interior margin from the housing floor and walls, satisfying the 1 mm clearance requirement.
The housing preserves its original five-surface enclosure geometry and placement without modification.
The button preserves its original geometry and placement on the front wall of the housing.
